method: Two separately assigned agent contexts assessed unchanged invented personas P001-P050 and P051-P100 with individual journey, rationale, blockers, confidence and evidence. The original realism brief and prior results remain unchanged. Ratings were not tuned to the requested +60 target. Conditional willingness is not counted as a purchase or a very-disappointed survey response. These are counterfactual forecasts, not 100 independent browser sessions.
groundTruth: Account-first quiz with reviewed CV/contact/experience and corrected owner/auth/lifecycle-bound record handoff; separate fact, variant and schedule confirmations; prior v34 three cadences/variants/recurring AI backend; new source-bound Deep Tailor and six public employer boards in current integrated source; recurring checkout mapping unfinished; no industry/visa filters; no repeated multi-day observation.
limitations: Source-informed subjective forecast has no statistical sampling or real-customer confidence interval.
Residence does not establish work authorisation or desired job location.
Six named boards do not establish broad field/geography coverage or a personal daily shortlist.
No new measured trial conversion, recurring retention, interview result or customer NPS.
Prior hosted recurring-backend evidence is separate from the current not-yet-deployed account/deep-tailoring changes.
